news.title: Hickey receives Fulbright award to study AI in education in Estonia
news.summary_en: Daniel Hickey, professor of learning sciences, will study and teach at the University of Tartu in Estonia from November 2026 through July 2027. In addition to teaching a graduate course and offering workshops and seminars on cybersecurity for future educators, he will support and study two nationwide, EU-funded projects during his Fulbright.
